0022600229.text: The Dallas Mavericks (7-4, 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, 9th in the West) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (8-3, 1st in the Northwest, 4th in the West) in Dallas's 12th game of the season, with the Mavericks on a three-game winning streak and 7-3 over their last ten. Minnesota is 4-1 at home and comes in on a four-game winning streak, while Dallas is 2-2 on the road, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Mavericks lost the season series 0-4, with the most recent meeting a 124-94 loss in Dallas on March 30, 2026. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a leg injury and a game-time decision, while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery).
